description: This file defines the EmployeeService class, which manages employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, and subordinate/supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, and hierarchy relationships within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeEventService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeTerminationService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns the IDGeneratorService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves an Employee entity and dispatches an EmployeeSavedEvent.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Generates a new ID and saves a new Employee entity.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating a new employee has been added.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates personal details of an employee and logs the event.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates job details of an employee and logs the event.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event when an employee's join date changes.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee by employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns total number of employees, optionally including terminated ones.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns list of subordinate employee numbers under a supervisor, including chain if supported.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns list of subordinate Employee objects under a supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a supervisor.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their employee numbers and dispatches an EmployeeDeletedEvent.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns list of supervisor employee numbers for a subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns employee data as an array, normalized for external use.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Returns employees available for work shifts based on search filters.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns employee numbers that cannot be deleted (e.g., current user, default admin in demo mode).

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email is unique among employees, considering current email if provided.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks if an employee ID is unique, considering current employee ID if provided.
